A five-step tour: centered welcome and finale cards, [pixelTourAnchor] and CSS ' +
      'selector targets, a circular spotlight, per-step button sets, and scrim-click skip. ' +
      'Arrow keys navigate; Escape aborts.

examples.title: Hooks, lazy targets & persistence
examples.description:
beforeEnter/afterLeave hooks stage the UI (opening a hidden panel), waitForTarget ' +
      'polls for content that arrives late (spinner + aria-busy meanwhile), and persistKey ' +
      'makes the tour run once: aborting saves the step for resume, finishing blocks re-runs.

examples.title: Autoplay, morph, drag & hands-on steps
examples.description:
The Phase 2 feature set: autoplay with a countdown bar (hover or keyboard focus ' +
      'pauses it; the pause button minimizes the tour to a floating chip), dot progress, a ' +
      'draggable card, a spotlight that morphs between targets (multi-target cutouts ' +
      'included), and an interactive "try it" step that advances when the real Deploy ' +
      'button is clicked.

examples.title: Template & component step bodies
examples.description:
Step content as an ng-template (implicit PixelTourRef context) or a component with ' +
      'PIXEL_TOUR_STEP_DATA — the default card chrome (title, footer, progress) stays in place.

examples.title: Custom card shell
examples.description:
ui: "custom" with config.card replaces the entire step panel — compose pixel-card (or any ' +
      'layout) and opt into pixel-tour-controls for standard navigation and progress.

examples.title: Headless (spotlight only)
examples.description:
ui: "headless" mounts only the scrim and spotlight — add pixel-tour-panel for the ' +
      'default card chrome above the scrim, or bind your own UI to PixelTourRef.

entries.title: Tree
entries.summary: Accessible TreeView for hierarchical data with single or cascading checkbox selection, lazy-loaded branches, virtualization, connector lines, drag-to-reorder, custom node templates, and the full WAI-ARIA tree keyboard contract.

inputs.name: nodes
inputs.description: Root nodes of the tree. Never mutated. Lazily loaded children are cached internally by node id, so replace node ids to force a reload.

inputs.name: selectionMode
inputs.description: Selection behavior. `single` selects one node via Enter/click (`aria-selected`); `checkbox` renders cascading checkboxes with indeterminate parents (`aria-checked`).

inputs.name: loadChildren
inputs.description: Async loader for `hasChildren` branches without inline `children`. Called once per node on first expansion; the row shows an inline loader and `aria-busy` while pending. Results are cached by node id.

inputs.name: ariaLabel
inputs.description: Accessible name for the tree. Required when the tree has no visible heading (`aria-label` on the host).

inputs.name: id
inputs.description: Optional element id override. Also prefixes the generated per-row ids used for roving focus.

inputs.name: emptyHeading
inputs.description: Heading for the built-in empty state shown when `nodes` is empty. Project `[pixelTreeEmpty]` content to replace the default empty state.

inputs.name: hideExpansionArrows
inputs.description: Hides the expand/collapse arrows (flat-list styling for shallow trees). Keyboard expansion still works; use only for trees that arrive expanded.

inputs.name: virtualScroll
inputs.description: Renders only the visible row window (fixed-height windowing over the flat list). Use for large expanded trees (10k+ visible rows). Pair with `virtualHeight`.

inputs.name: rowHeight
inputs.description: Fixed row stride in px for virtualization. `0` derives from the component token defaults (node block-size + row gap).

inputs.name: virtualHeight
inputs.description: Scroll viewport height in px when `virtualScroll` is enabled.

inputs.name: virtualOverscan
inputs.description: Extra rows rendered above/below the viewport to smooth fast scrolling.

inputs.name: showConnectors
inputs.description: Draws ancestor connector lines in the indent gutter (hierarchy guide lines). When enabled, each row renders L-shaped branch guides instead of plain padding indentation — useful for org charts, file trees, and reorderable task lists.

inputs.name: reorderable
inputs.description: Enables drag-to-reorder among sibling nodes (HTML5 drag on the handle). Emits `nodeReorder`; the consumer updates `nodes`. Drops are limited to siblings at the same level.

inputs.name: dragReorderLabel
inputs.description: Tooltip / title for the drag-reorder handle when `reorderable` is on.

inputs.name: expandedIds
inputs.description: Expanded node ids — two-way.

inputs.name: selectedIds
inputs.description: Selected node ids — two-way. In `checkbox` mode contains the full cascaded closure.

outputs.name: nodeToggle
outputs.description: Emits when a branch expands or collapses.

outputs.name: selectionChange
outputs.description: Emits on every selection change with the node that caused it.

outputs.name: nodeActivate
outputs.description: Emits when a node is activated (Enter or click on its content).

outputs.name: nodeReorder
outputs.description: Emits when the user drops a dragged node onto a sibling target.

overview: pixel-tree renders a flattened visible-row list (indentation via CSS var, one @for) — virtualScroll windowing keeps 10k+ visible rows fast.
expandedIds and selectedIds are two-way models; nodes are never mutated, and lazily loaded children are cached internally by node id.
Checkbox mode cascades selection to descendants and derives checked/indeterminate parent state; reorderable emits nodeReorder for sibling drag-and-drop.
useCases: File and folder explorers
Organization / permission trees with cascading checkbox selection
Nested settings and taxonomy pickers with lazily loaded branches
Large expanded hierarchies with virtualScroll
themingNotes: Component tokens: --pixel-tree-node-block-size, --pixel-tree-indent, --pixel-tree-color, --pixel-tree-hover-background, --pixel-tree-selected-background, --pixel-tree-selected-color, --pixel-tree-radius, --pixel-tree-connector-color.
Indentation is logical (padding-inline-start) and the expand chevron mirrors under [dir=rtl].
accessibilityNotes: role="tree"/"treeitem" with aria-level, aria-posinset, aria-setsize on every row (flat pattern).
Roving tabindex; ArrowUp/Down move, ArrowRight expands or enters, ArrowLeft collapses or goes to the parent, Home/End jump, Enter activates/selects, Space toggles, typeahead and * expand siblings.
aria-expanded on branches, aria-selected in single mode, aria-checked (incl. "mixed") in checkbox mode, aria-busy while a branch loads.
Disabled nodes stay focusable (per WAI-ARIA) but cannot be selected or toggled.
entries.behaviorNotes:
- **Flat render model**: only visible rows exist in the DOM — one `@for` over a flattened
  `computed()` list; hierarchy is conveyed by `aria-level`/`aria-posinset`/`aria-setsize`
  and CSS-var indentation. This is the contract Phase 3 virtualization builds on.
- **Labels / i18n:** `dragReorderLabel` sets the drag-handle `title` when `reorderable`
  (default `"Drag to reorder"`).
- **Keyboard focus indication is the hover surface, not a focus ring** (design decision):
  `:focus-visible` rows show the same background tint as pointer hover; selected rows keep
  their stronger primary tint instead. There is deliberately no outline on tree rows.
- **Keyboard map** (WAI-ARIA tree, roving tabindex — one row has `tabindex="0"`):
  ArrowDown/ArrowUp move; ArrowRight expands a closed branch, else moves to the first child;
  ArrowLeft collapses an open branch, else moves to the parent; Home/End jump to the first/
  last visible row; Enter selects (single mode) and emits `nodeActivate`; Space toggles
  selection; printable-character **typeahead** jumps to the next matching label (wraps); `*`
  expands every expandable sibling at the same level.
- **Selection semantics**: `single` — Enter/click toggles the one selected id
  (`aria-selected`). `checkbox` — toggling a node applies its whole descendant closure to
  `selectedIds`; parent states are *derived* (all → checked, some → `aria-checked="mixed"`),
  and for unloaded lazy branches the stored id decides. Disabled nodes are focusable but
  never selectable/toggleable.
- **The row checkbox IS `pixel-checkbox`, embedded decoratively**: the component renders
  with `aria-hidden="true"`, `tabIndex="-1"`, and `pointer-events: none`, so it contributes
  no tab stop, no screen-reader node, and no click target — the `treeitem` row owns all
  interaction and exposes the state via `aria-checked` (incl. `"mixed"`), per the WAI-ARIA
  tree pattern. Visuals therefore stay automatically in sync with `pixel-checkbox` theming.
  The expand/collapse chevron is a plain glyph with no hover surface of its own — the whole
  row is the hover/interaction target.
- **Lazy loading**: a `hasChildren` node without `children` calls `loadChildren` once on
  first expansion (`aria-busy` + inline loader while pending); results are cached by node id
  for the component's lifetime — change the node id to force a refetch. The input `nodes`
  array is never mutated.
- **Two-way state**: `expandedIds`/`selectedIds` are `model()`s — parents may bind, own, or
  ignore them. `expandAll()`/`collapseAll()` are public methods.
- **Empty state**: with zero nodes the tree renders a built-in `pixel-empty-state`
  (`emptyHeading`), replaceable via projected `[pixelTreeEmpty]` content.
- **Virtualization**: `virtualScroll` slices the flat row list to a fixed-height window
  (`virtualHeight`, `rowHeight`, `virtualOverscan`) — keyboard navigation scrolls the active
  row into view automatically.
- **Connector lines**: `showConnectors` draws L-shaped hierarchy guide lines in the indent
  gutter (each flat row carries `ancestorContinues` / `isLastChild`). Off by default — enable
  for file explorers, org charts, and reorderable lists.
- **Drag reorder**: `reorderable` uses the same index move model as query-builder: drop on a
  sibling to move the dragged node to that sibling’s index (`fromIndex` → `toIndex` on
  `nodeReorder`). No before/after half-row zones. While dragging, the source row fades with a
  dashed frame and an opaque floating preview follows the pointer; the target row gets a soft
  primary tint.
- RTL: indentation uses logical padding and the chevron mirrors under `[dir='rtl']`.

examples.title: File explorer (single selection)
examples.description:
Nested nodes with icons, hierarchy connector lines (`showConnectors`), two-way ' +
      'expandedIds/selectedIds, a disabled node, and the full WAI-ARIA keyboard map.

examples.title: Checkbox cascade + lazy loading
examples.description:
Checkbox mode cascades to descendants and derives indeterminate parents; hasChildren ' +
      'branches call loadChildren on first expansion with an inline loader and aria-busy. ' +
      'showConnectors draws hierarchy guide lines in the indent gutter.

examples.title: 10,000 nodes (virtual scroll)
examples.description:
virtualScroll renders only the visible row window over the flat list — pair with ' +
      'virtualHeight for large expanded trees without thousands of DOM nodes.

examples.title: Drag to reorder siblings
examples.description:
reorderable matches query-builder: drop on a sibling row to move to that index ' +
      '(fromIndex → toIndex). Opaque floating preview + soft drop-target tint; pair with showConnectors.
